title: ICA Clarifier Output
description: Structured decision object emitted by an Intent Compression Architecture control layer before answer generation.

query_id.description: Optional identifier linking the decision object to an external trace or request log.

ambiguity_score.description: Estimated ambiguity of the user query.

risk_score.description: Estimated safety or premise risk associated with literal compliance.

intent_entropy_bits.description: Entropy of the current intent distribution in bits.

risk_labels.description: Optional categorical risk labels such as defamation_risk, medical_risk, or false_premise.

intent_hypotheses.description: Plausible intent interpretations and their current probabilities.

candidate_clarifiers.description: Optional ranked candidate clarification questions considered by the controller.

decision.description: Routing decision selected by the control layer.

selected_clarifier_id.description: Identifier of the selected clarifier when decision is ask_clarifier or premise_check.

clarifying_question.description: Question to present to the user when clarification is selected.

expected_utility.description: Expected utility of the selected decision or clarifier.

decision_threshold.description: Domain-specific threshold used to decide whether clarification is worth the extra turn.

answer_constraints.description: Constraints or handling instructions that should condition the final answer.

safe_redirect.description: Suggested safe redirection when the correct action is refusal or constrained assistance.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of the routing decision for debugging or trace review.
